brief:
UNRWA has reduced employee salaries as the agency continues to face an unresolved financial crisis, Shehab Wire reported. Adnan Abu Hasna, media adviser for the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees, said the funding shortfall persists despite the agency's continued provision of services and resumption of educational operations.

The salary cuts reflect mounting pressures on UNRWA's budget as it attempts to maintain core functions across its operations serving Palestinian refugees.
dek: UNRWA has reduced employee salaries as the agency continues to face an unresolved financial crisis, Shehab Wire reported.
title: UNRWA cuts staff salaries amid ongoing financial crisis
